root_cause.text: The FAN_FROM_REG macro evaluates its arguments multiple times without proper locking, allowing concurrent modification of shared driver data (fan_min, fan_div) between evaluations, leading to TOCTOU race conditions and potential divide-by-zero errors.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "The macro FAN_FROM_REG evaluates its arguments multiple times. When used in lockless contexts involving shared driver data, this leads to Time-of-Check to Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) race conditions, potentially causing divide-by-zero errors." The patch converts the macro to a static function and moves the minimum-limit calculation inside the update lock in store_fan_div to ensure atomic read-modify-write.
